title: TelecomGPT-R1: A Unified Open-Source Reasoner for the Telecom Stack
abstract: arXiv:2608.26126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Telecommunications is a high-leverage domain for large language model (LLM)-based reasoning because routine engineering workflows require joint grounding in normative specifications, operational telemetry, vendor-specific fault evidence, and exact RF/network calculations. However, current LLM integration in telecom remains bottlenecked by a two-sided capability gap: generic reasoners often lack telecom-specific grounding, while domain-specific telecom LLMs remain limited in structured, multi-step reasoning. To bridge this gap, we release TelecomGPT-R1-9B, a unified open-source telecom reasoner that ranks top-performing on the GSMA open telco leaderboard. Specifically, we curate a 67,427-example supervised fine-tuning (SFT) corpus organized around four complementary reasoning axes: protocol, knowledge, modeling, and fault. The corpus is built from axis-matched public web sources and enhanced through axis-specific chain-of-thought (CoT) ge

translated_title: TelecomGPT-R1：面向电信栈的统一开源推理器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26126v1 公告类型：新 摘要：电信是基于大型语言模型（LLM）推理的高杠杆领域，因为日常工程工作流需要同时基于规范标准、运营遥测、供应商特定的故障证据以及精确的射频/网络计算。然而，当前LLM在电信中的集成仍受制于两方面的能力差距：通用推理器往往缺乏电信特定基础，而领域特定的电信LLM在结构化、多步推理方面仍显不足。为弥合这一差距，我们发布了TelecomGPT-R1-9B，一个统一的开源电信推理器，在GSMA开放电信排行榜上排名顶尖。具体而言，我们策划了一个包含67,427个示例的监督微调（SFT）语料库，围绕四个互补的推理轴组织：协议、知识、建模和故障。该语料库基于与轴匹配的公共网络来源构建，并通过轴特定的思维链（CoT）生成增强。
tldr: 本文发布了TelecomGPT-R1-9B，一个统一的开源电信推理器，通过围绕协议、知识、建模和故障四个推理轴的67,427个示例监督微调语料库，结合轴特定思维链增强，在GSMA开放电信排行榜上取得顶尖性能，弥合了通用推理器与领域特定电信LLM之间的能力差距。
en_tdlr: This paper releases TelecomGPT-R1-9B, a unified open-source telecom reasoner that achieves top performance on the GSMA open telco leaderboard by curating a 67,427-example SFT corpus organized around four reasoning axes (protocol, knowledge, modeling, fault) enhanced with axis-specific chain-of-thought, bridging the gap between generic reasoners and domain-specific telecom LLMs.
